LESSON: MASS

Grade: PP2
Subject: MATHEMATICS ACTIVITIES
Strand: Strand 3
Topic 3.2: Mass

SECTION 1: WELCOME

Hello! This is a study lesson on Mass. Read the explanation, follow every worked example, then do the practice. This is original CBC Learn content written from KICD outcomes — not a copy of a commercial textbook.

SECTION 2: WHAT YOU WILL LEARN

By the end of this lesson, you will be able to:

1. appreciate objects of different mass (play on a sea saw; back to mass in their environment back lifting) 68
2. enjoy manipulating objects of • Listen to stories on heavy/ light different mass in daily life objects. experiences •

SECTION 3: STUDY NOTES (READ AND LEARN)

WHAT YOU ARE LEARNING: MASS
Mass is a Grade mathematics skill used at school, at the market, and at home.

HOW TO STUDY THIS TOPIC
1. Read each idea slowly.
2. Copy every worked example into your book and recalculate it yourself.
3. Then try the practice questions without looking at the answers.

WORKED EXAMPLE STYLE
Write the question clearly. Show each step. Box the final answer.
Example framework:
  Question: (write a Mass problem)
  Step 1: …
  Step 2: …
  Answer: …

KENYAN CONTEXT
Use shillings, market goods, school desks, or garden plots as story numbers so the maths feels real.

SECTION 4: QUICK EXAMPLES

Example 1: Solve one simple Mass question using objects or a drawing.

Example 2: Solve a harder Mass question showing every step.

Example 3: Make a word problem about Mass set at a Kenyan market.

SECTION 5: PRACTICE NOW

1. Write and solve five questions on Mass.
2. Explain one solution aloud to a parent or friend.
3. Invent one new word problem and solve it.

SECTION 6: WORK TO DO (HOME / REVISION)

1. Complete 10 practice questions on Mass in your exercise book.
2. Mark your work. Redo any question you missed.
3. Teach a younger learner one method from this lesson.

SECTION: REMEMBER

1. appreciate objects of different mass (play on a sea saw; back to mass in their environment back lifting) 68
2. enjoy manipulating objects of • Listen to stories on heavy/ light different mass in daily life objects. experiences •

Now complete the Revision Quiz. Open Answers only after you finish.
